cvt_f2h.op.why: The audit's stated reason ('does not reproduce across the two gated runs at >=99% agreement') rests on m4_20260828_run03 and/or run05, which EXP-0144's own RESULTS.md disowns ('run01-run05 ... back no label'), and on never-dispatched `skipped_after_hangs` placeholders scored as observations. With placeholders dropped the same run pair agrees far better -- for five unpack_convert fields the audit's 0.00% becomes 100.00%. BUT once the disowned runs are excluded EXP-0144 has only ONE admissible run per instrument, so the field re-scores SINGLE-RUN, not STABLE-LIVE: it cannot clear a CROSS-RUN gate on committed evidence either way. Note EXP-0144 RESULTS.md 6.5 states it deliberately used a WITHIN-RUN majority-of-3 (escalated to 5) control instead of a cross-run gate, and why. Whether that control is accepted in place of a cross-run pair is an orchestrator policy call, not something this audit can settle.
